Description: Allows caster to research special imbedding spells to be used in creating items
Allows the caster to imbed a first level Mentalism or Channeling spell in an item or potion
Allows the caster to charge a wand that casts Mentalism or Channeling spells (or has Mentalism or Channeling abilities) back to its full number of charges
As Imbed I, except up to a second level spell can be imbedded
Allows the caster make an imbedded first level spell (in an item) usable once per day. Note that the caster must also cast an Imbed spell to place the spell in the item
As Imbed I, except up to a third spell can be imbedded
As Charge Wand, except rods (with Mentalism or Channeling spells/abilities) can be charged
As Daily I, except the item can have up to a third level spell that can be cast either three times per day (for a first level spell) or one time per day (for a second or third level spell)
As Imbed I, except up to a fourth level spell can be imbedded
As Imbed I, except up to a fifth level spell can be imbedded

As Daily I, except the item can have up to a fifth level spell that can be cast either four times per day (for a first level spell), three times per day (for a second level spell), two times per day (for a third level spell), or one time per day (for a fourth or fifth level spell)
As Imbed I, except up to a sixth level spell can be imbedded
As Imbed I, except up to a eighth level spell can be imbedded
As Charge Wand, except staves (with Mentalism or Channeling spells/abilities) can be charged
As Imbed I, except up to a tenth level spell can be imbedded

As Daily I, except the item can have up to a tenth level spell that can be cast either five times per day (for a first level spell), four times per day (for a second or third level spell), three times per day (for a fourth or fifth level spell), two times per day (for a sixth or seventh level spell), or one time per day (for an eighth, ninth, or tenth level spell)

As Daily True, except certain spells can be imbedded to operate constantly. See Section 7.4 for restrictions on what spells can be made constant. SPECIAL NOTES See Section 7.4 for more information on alchemy. MENT./CHAN. IMBEDDING
